what: P3 Panel B analysis, the frozen pre-registration (sections 4 and 6)

interpretations.point_and_interval: a success criterion stated as a value 'with its CI excluding 0' (H3 reduction, H4 gain) needs the point estimate to meet the value AND the CI's lower bound > 0
interpretations.thresholds_on_points: H1-b (>= 0.85), H3 (<= 15%, <= 25%) and H5 (within 5 points) are judged on point estimates; their CIs are reported
interpretations.h3k_both_seeds: H3-k is computed for S2-D seeds 0 and 1; a method passes only if it passes on both (as H3 and H2 require both seeds)
interpretations.h3k_shift_reference: (S)'s 'validation reals' are the 891 reals the k = 0 threshold is fitted on (491 COCO validation + 400 held-out Open Images)
interpretations.h3k_judged_per_pool: 'judged on E4 and E5': each of E4 and E5 must reach the 80% share
interpretations.h5_absolute: 'within 5 AUC points of clean' is |macro AUC(condition) - macro AUC(clean)| <= 0.05 on the four unseen slices, Panel B test rows
interpretations.h3k_ece: ECE is over the view's test reals and test fakes; (Q) applies no shift, so its ECE equals k = 0's

H1b.claim_needs: H1-a PASS and H1-b on >= 2 of 3 folds (section 7)
